audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot sanctuary instruction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for incense altar, ransom/census silver, bronze basin, anointing oil, incense blend, holiness restrictions.

verses.restored: You shall make altar for burning incense; of acacia wood you shall make it.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.

modern.text: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: A cubit its length and a cubit its width, square it shall be, and two cubits its height; its horns from it.

familiar.text: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.

modern.text: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.

original.text: אַמָּ֨ה אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְאַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָת֑וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: Overlay it with pure gold, its top, sides all around, and horns; make for it gold molding all around.

familiar.text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

modern.text: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.

original.text: וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Two gold rings make for it under molding on two sides; make on two sides, as housings for poles to carry it.

familiar.text: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.

modern.text: And make two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.

original.text: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לּ֣וֹ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו וְהָיָה֙ לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֵֽמָּה

verses.restored: Make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

modern.text: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב

verses.restored: Put it before veil that is over ark of testimony, before cover over testimony, where I meet with you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

modern.text: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony —before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: Aaron shall burn on it fragrant incense morning by morning; when he dresses lamps, he shall burn it.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

modern.text: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.

original.text: וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר בְּהֵיטִיב֛וֹ אֶת הַנֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה

verses.restored: And when Aaron raises lamps between evenings, he shall burn it, continual incense before YHWH throughout generations.

familiar.text: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

modern.text: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.

original.text: וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעֲרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall not offer upon it strange incense, burnt offering, grain offering, and drink offering you shall not pour on it.

familiar.text: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

modern.text: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.

original.text: לֹא תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה וְנֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽיו

verses.restored: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in year with blood/life of sin/misalignment offering of atonements; once in year he shall make atonement upon it throughout generations. Holy of Holies it is to YHWH.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD.

modern.text: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the LORD.” The Census Offering (2 Samuel 24:1–9; 1 Chronicles 21:1–6)

original.text: וְכִפֶּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל קַרְנֹתָ֔יו אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה מִדַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּשָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם קֹֽדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: When you lift head of children of Israel according to their counted ones, each shall give ransom/covering of one's soul/life to YHWH when counting them, so no plague be among them when counting.

familiar.text: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

modern.text: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.

original.text: כִּ֣י תִשָּׂ֞א אֶת רֹ֥אשׁ בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם֒ וְנָ֨תְנ֜וּ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּ֧פֶר נַפְשׁ֛וֹ לַיהוָ֖ה בִּפְקֹ֣ד אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה בָהֶ֛ם נֶ֖גֶף בִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: This they shall give, everyone passing over to counted ones: half shekel by shekel of sanctuary, twenty gerahs the shekel; half shekel as contribution to YHWH.

familiar.text: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.

modern.text: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.

original.text: זֶ֣ה יִתְּנ֗וּ כָּל הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים גֵּרָה֙ הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל מַחֲצִ֣ית הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Everyone passing over to counted ones, from son of twenty years and upward, shall give contribution of YHWH.

familiar.text: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.

modern.text: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.

original.text: כֹּ֗ל הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה יִתֵּ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: The rich shall not increase and poor shall not diminish from half shekel, to give contribution of YHWH to make atonement over your souls/lives.

familiar.text: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

modern.text: In making the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives, the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.

original.text: הֶֽעָשִׁ֣יר לֹֽא יַרְבֶּ֗ה וְהַדַּל֙ לֹ֣א יַמְעִ֔יט מִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית הַשָּׁ֑קֶל לָתֵת֙ אֶת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Take silver of atonements from children of Israel and give it for service of tent of meeting; it shall be for children of Israel as memorial before YHWH, to make atonement over your souls/lives.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

modern.text: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.” The Bronze Basin (Exodus 38:8)

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ אֶת כֶּ֣סֶף הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ עַל עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֩ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Make bronze basin and bronze stand for washing; put it between tent of meeting and altar, and put water there.

familiar.text: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

modern.text: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ כִּיּ֥וֹר נְחֹ֛שֶׁת וְכַנּ֥וֹ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְרָחְצָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ בֵּֽין אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖מָּה מָֽיִם

verses.restored: Aaron and his sons shall wash from it their hands and their feet.

familiar.text: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

modern.text: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.

original.text: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: When they enter tent of meeting, they shall wash with water so they do not die; or when they approach altar to minister, to turn smoke of fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:

modern.text: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made by fire to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.

original.text: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד יִרְחֲצוּ מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֔ת לְהַקְטִ֥יר אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: They shall wash their hands and feet so they do not die; it shall be age-long statute for them, for him and his seed throughout generations.

familiar.text: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

modern.text: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.” The Anointing Oil

original.text: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ יְדֵיהֶ֥ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם חָק עוֹלָ֛ם ל֥וֹ וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: You take for yourself chief spices: flowing myrrh five hundred, fragrant cinnamon half of it, two hundred fifty, fragrant cane two hundred fifty,

familiar.text: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,

modern.text: “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח לְךָ֮ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר דְּרוֹר֙ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְקִנְּמָן בֶּ֥שֶׂם מַחֲצִית֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וּקְנֵה בֹ֖שֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם

verses.restored: cassia five hundred by sanctuary shekel, and olive oil a hin.

familiar.text: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

modern.text: 500 shekels of cassia —all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.

original.text: וְקִדָּ֕ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְשֶׁ֥מֶן זַ֖יִת הִֽין

verses.restored: Make it holy anointing oil, perfume mixture, work of perfumer; holy anointing oil it shall be.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

modern.text: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ אֹת֗וֹ שֶׁ֚מֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹ֔דֶשׁ רֹ֥קַח מִרְקַ֖חַת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑חַ שֶׁ֥מֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Anoint with it tent of meeting and ark of testimony,

familiar.text: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

modern.text: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,

original.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ ב֖וֹ אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָעֵדֻֽת

verses.restored: table and all its vessels, lampstand and its vessels, incense altar,

familiar.text: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

modern.text: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense,

original.text: וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת

verses.restored: altar of burnt offering and all its vessels, basin and its stand.

familiar.text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

modern.text: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.

original.text: וְאֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת כַּנּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Sanctify them, and they shall be Holy of Holies; all touching them shall be holy.

familiar.text: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

modern.text: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

original.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהָי֖וּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֑ים כָּל הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ

verses.restored: Aaron and his sons you shall anoint, and sanctify them to serve as priests to me.

familiar.text: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

modern.text: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.

original.text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְאֶת בָּנָ֖יו תִּמְשָׁ֑ח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי

verses.restored: To children of Israel speak, saying, Holy anointing oil this shall be to me throughout your generations.

familiar.text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

modern.text: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

original.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר שֶׁ֠מֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה זֶ֛ה לִ֖י לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Upon flesh of human it shall not be poured, and by its composition you shall not make like it; holy it is, holy it shall be to you.

familiar.text: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

modern.text: It must not be used to anoint an ordinary man, and you must not make anything like it with the same formula. It is holy, and it must be holy to you.

original.text: עַל בְּשַׂ֤ר אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א יִיסָ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֨תְכֻּנְתּ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּמֹ֑הוּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Whoever mixes like it or puts from it on stranger shall be cut off from one's people.

familiar.text: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

modern.text: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’” The Incense

original.text: אִ֚ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְקַ֣ח כָּמֹ֔הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִתֵּ֛ן מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַל זָ֑ר וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Take for yourself fragrant spices: stacte, onycha, galbanum, fragrant spices with pure frankincense; equal part to equal part shall it be.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

modern.text: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures,

original.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֜ה קַח לְךָ֣ סַמִּ֗ים נָטָ֤ף וּשְׁחֵ֨לֶת֙ וְחֶלְבְּנָ֔ה סַמִּ֖ים וּלְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה בַּ֥ד בְּבַ֖ד יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Make it incense, perfume mixture, work of perfumer, salted, pure, holy.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:

modern.text: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֹתָהּ֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת רֹ֖קַח מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רוֹקֵ֑חַ מְמֻלָּ֖ח טָה֥וֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: Beat some of it very fine, and put some before testimony in tent of meeting where I meet with you; Holy of Holies it shall be to you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

modern.text: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

original.text: וְשָֽׁחַקְתָּ֣ מִמֶּנָּה֮ הָדֵק֒ וְנָתַתָּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נָּה לִפְנֵ֤י הָעֵדֻת֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: The incense you make, by its composition you shall not make for yourselves; holy to YHWH it shall be to you.

familiar.text: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.

modern.text: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.

original.text: וְהַקְּטֹ֨רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה בְּמַ֨תְכֻּנְתָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Whoever makes like it to smell it shall be cut off from one's people.

familiar.text: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

modern.text: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”

original.text: אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמ֖וֹהָ לְהָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑הּ וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו

translation_notes: Incense altar is tied to lamp tending morning/evening: fragrance and light rhythms are linked.
Census silver is equal for rich and poor; life-value before YHWH is not scaled by wealth.
Basin washing marks priestly approach with bodily preparation and ritual safety.
Anointing oil/incense restrictions protect holy mixtures from ordinary/private appropriation.
safety_note: Do not use census/ransom language to imply richer lives are worth more; the text explicitly forbids rich increasing or poor decreasing the half-shekel.
